title: Mordheim KB catalogue — catalog/items/*.yaml
description: Canonical item records, split by category (`weapons-close-combat`, `armour`, `miscellaneous`, `trollheim`, …). Every file of `catalog/items/` carries the same shape: the envelope and its item records. Item ids are stable and reference the executable layer through `mechanic_id`.

kind.description: Item category; it matches the file the record lives in (`trollheim-equipment` for the Trollheim catalogue, `out-of-scope` for records kept only for reference).

effect.description: Editorial text of the item as printed in its source.

combat_status.description: `implemented` items drive the duel runtime through their mechanic; `out_of_scope` items are carried for the campaign runtime and the UI only.

mechanic_id.description: Mechanic of `catalog/mechanics/close-combat.yaml` that implements the item.

allOf.description: An implemented item must name the mechanic that implements it (`load_simulation_mappings` fails without it).
